rules: P2 DECISION-AUTHORITY.md §3 A1-A9 with the §5 v0.2 changes C1-C5

decisions.statement: run-interest charges collection interest of 1% of the invoice amount, rounded to the cent half away from zero, once per invoice, when today is more than 60 days after the due date (today > due + 60 days) and the invoice is still unpaid; it prints 'interest charged: N'.
'Still unpaid' is read the same way the existing late-fee rule reads it: something is still outstanding on the invoice (outstanding > 0).

Collection interest is charged on every invoice that DEC-B14 says owes it, including invoices of nonprofit customers. The existing nonprofit exclusion (Rules.chased) is used only for late fees and is not applied to interest, because neither DEC-B14 nor BILL-43 states that exception. This is recorded as an open question for Credit Control.

Charged interest is stored on the invoice (new Invoice.Interest field) and included in Rules.outstanding, so it counts in the customer's balance. 'show is unchanged' is read as: the show output format is unchanged (no new field); its outstanding figure is the invoice's outstanding and therefore includes interest.

help (Cli.usage) lists 'run-interest' directly after 'run-late-fees'; run-interest takes no arguments, so extra arguments get the standard 'error: usage: run-interest' refusal. The README command list is updated to match.
